title: Yellowed Golden Croatian Taleggio Frittata
description: A briny and shattering Croatian dish featuring taleggio cheese, perfect for a brunch mood, with a unique wok-hei flavor and nut-free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sliced taleggio cheese and cook for 2 minutes until melted and slightly browned.
Pour the whisked eggs over the cheese and garlic mixture.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes until the eggs start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes until the eggs are almost set.
Remove the skillet from the oven and sprinkle the chopped parsley on top.
Return the skillet to the oven and bake for an additional 1 minute until the eggs are fully set.
